snippet.title: Rogue Descent Launch trailer
snippet.description:
Rogue Descent is a challenging roguelite dungeon crawler that features auto battler mechanics, strategic gameplay, and a variety of unique enemies and bosses.

Available now on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078920?utm_source=yt
